en.t: The noodle shop stood on the riverbank.

units.source_text: 这条河大概也是从温泉浴场流过来的。

en.t: This river, too, probably flowed down from the hot spring baths.

units.source_text: 可以看到尼姑三三两两地先后走过桥去。

en.t: Nuns could be seen crossing the bridge one after another in twos and threes.

units.source_text: 她们穿着草鞋，其中有的背着圆顶草帽，像是化缘回来的样子，给人一种小鸟急于归巢的感觉。

en.t: They wore straw sandals, and some carried round straw hats on their backs, as if returning from begging for alms, giving the impression of little birds hurrying back to their nests.
